easyPrerequisites: Jumbo Cactuar does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Cast Windswift Slice by paying {2}{G}, causing Jumbo Cactuar to deal damage equal to its power to an opponent's creature and to create a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token for each point of excess damage dealt this way.
